findings.why_it_matters: In 14.9.40.3 SUBTRACT general rules 1 and 2 the subscripts 1, 2, n on operand-1 are flattened into the operand name, so 'operand-11' and 'operand-12' read as operands eleven and twelve instead of the first and second occurrences of operand-1; the arithmetic-expression equivalence that defines the initial evaluation is garbled.

findings.pdf_says: UNLOCK file-name-1 [ RECORD / RECORDS ]  (one line: UNLOCK, then file-name-1, then a bracket stacking RECORD over RECORDS)
findings.why_it_matters: The 14.9.43.1 general format puts file-name-1 on a separate row beneath UNLOCK, so the drawing reads as UNLOCK followed by the RECORD/RECORDS bracket with file-name-1 dangling or stacked under UNLOCK; the operand order UNLOCK file-name-1 [RECORD|RECORDS] is not shown on one line as the standard prints it.
